name: DOMINICAN REP

flag.title: Flag of DR
flag.note: Blue & red quartered by a white cross

lead: The Dominican Republic shares the island of Hispaniola with Haiti. It has tall peaks, salt lakes below sea level, rainforests and 1,600 km of beach. Its capital, Santo Domingo, is the oldest European city in the Americas.

sections.wows: Seven things to make you gasp

geo: The country covers the eastern two-thirds of Hispaniola. Pico Duarte, at 3,098 m, is the Caribbean's tallest peak.
Lake Enriquillo lies 46 m below sea level, the Caribbean's lowest point. It is saltier than the sea. Crocodiles and flamingos live there.
animals: The palmchat is the national bird. It is the only one in its whole bird family and lives nowhere else on Earth.
The rhinoceros iguana has horn-like lumps on its snout. Every January, over 1,500 humpback whales gather in Samaná Bay to breed.
culture: The dance music merengue (UNESCO 2016) and bachata (UNESCO 2019) were both born here. Bachata began as music of the poor.
The country leads the world in organic cocoa. Miners dig larimar, a sky-blue gemstone found only on one hillside. Amber (hardened tree sap) here holds 20-million-year-old insects.
history: Santo Domingo was founded in 1498. The Americas' first cathedral, university, castle and monastery were all built here. Spain used it as a launch pad to conquer a hemisphere.
The country declared independence from Haiti in 1844. It is the only nation to win independence from another Caribbean country. Independence hero Juan Pablo Duarte designed its blue-and-red flag.
wows: A Dominican child is 5x more likely to play Major League Baseball than a US child.
The gemstone larimar is found on only one hillside on Earth, in Barahona Province.
Santo Domingo's 1498 street grid became the model for almost every Spanish city in the Americas.
Lake Enriquillo is saltier than the ocean and 46 m below sea level, yet crocodiles live there.
Over 1,500 humpback whales gather in Samaná Bay each winter, one of Earth's biggest whale gatherings.
Dominican amber, up to 20 million years old, holds the oldest blood droplets ever found in resin.
Bachata was banned from Dominican radio as 'gutter music', then UNESCO named it world heritage.

myths.myth: Columbus first landed in the Dominican Republic
myths.fact: His first landing was in the Bahamas in 1492. He reached Hispaniola months later.

myths.myth: Hurricanes spin the same way everywhere
myths.fact: North of the equator they spin anticlockwise. South of it, they spin clockwise.
